Package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.html

Interface HTMLRewriter

All Superinterfaces:
org.teavm.jso.JSObject
public interface HTMLRewriter extends org.teavm.jso.JSObject
Rewrites an HTML response as it streams, with Java handlers.

transform(Response) returns at once and the platform calls the handlers while whoever holds the new response reads its body, which can be after the handler that built it has returned. A handler that throws stops the parse and errors the new body with the exception; the client sees a truncated response if part of it was already sent.

Each handler call runs on its own fiber and the platform waits for it before it goes on, so a handler can wait on a binding or a fetch, as the platform's async handlers can. A call costs a fiber, so register only the kinds you need: on with a class that implements one interface registers one callback, and each extra interface adds one. 

 Response page = HTMLRewriter.create()
     .on("a", link -> link.setAttribute("target", "_blank"))
     .on("body", body -> body.prepend("<p>hello</p>", ContentOptions.html()))
     .transform(origin);
Since:
1.0.3
